messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-gateway symptom=5xx_rate>3.5% (1m) 

alice_oncall: acked INC1753214321 :white_check_mark: I'm on it

bob_infra: seeing a burst of 502/504 from west1 -> edge-proxy pool, latency high

alice_oncall: confirmed start ~1753214200, canary-rtx traffic ~6x baseline

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC1753214321 acknowledged by alice_oncall

carol_sre: @alice_oncall did HPA trigger? I don't see new replicas for inference-gateway-canary

alice_oncall: HPA didn't scale — max pods hit in canary ASG, scale failed: `quota exceeded`

bob_infra: noticing OOM evictions on canary pods, kubelet logs snippet:
```
Mar 17 07:02:01 kubelet[...] : eviction manager: attempting to free 512Mi
Mar 17 07:02:04 kubelet[...] : killing container "inference-gateway-canary"
```

dave_support: customer impact? Support dashboard shows a handful of 502s for pilot keys

alice_oncall: initial estimate <1% traffic impacted but concentrated; escalating priority

carol_sre: mitigation proposal: 1) shift canary traffic -> stable pool, 2) scale stable pool, 3) warm KV cache

alice_oncall: doing step 1 now: updating traffic-router weights `canary:5% -> 0%`

alice_oncall: running `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/inference-gateway-canary -n prod-canary` to stop thrash

bob_infra: overriding autoscaler to add +3 nodes to stable pool (temporary), ETA ~2m

alice_oncall: watchers — look for restart loops or continuing OOMs after divert

dave_support: pinging CS to prep customer comms: small set of pilot customers affected

carol_sre: applying PD suppression to avoid noisy duplicate pages: `pd-suppress INC1753214321` (done)

alice_oncall: suppression confirmed, monitoring 5xx

alice_oncall: 5xx rate falling to 0.9% — divert appears effective :thumbsup:

bob_infra: new nodes registering, stable pods healthy, kvcache warming

alice_oncall: will incrementally reintroduce canary in 5m if stable holds

carol_sre: assigning postmortem to bob_infra + infra-ops for quota/accounting review

dave_support: customer update: "We rerouted a small subset of pilot traffic and restored service; investigating root cause."

alice_oncall: handing off follow-up to morning oncall @eve_oncall for postmortem and remediation

eve_oncall: taking ownership, will coordinate blameless postmortem and follow-ups

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC1753214321 resolved by eve_oncall

alice_oncall: thread summary: canary resource exhaustion -> traffic diversion -> stable pool absorbed load -> suppression to reduce noise. Follow-ups: quota checks, autoscale fallback, and graceful canary drains
